issue.title: Enhancement: Add J2 and J2C+ ASIC variants to _try_get_brcm_asic_name

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

Add J2 and J2C+ ASIC variants to _try_get_brcm_asic_name

### Current Behavior

_try_get_brcm_asic_name in tests/common/devices/sonic.py identifies Broadcom ASICs by matching lspci output against known PCI device identifiers. Currently, Jericho 2 (J2) and Jericho 2C+ (J2C+) ASICs are not included in the search_sets dictionary, causing get_asic_name() to return UNKNOWN_ASIC for devices using these chipsets. Adding it will allow the use of calls like: `self.duthost.get_asic_name()`

### Proposed Behavior

Add J2 and J2C+ entries to the search_sets dictionary in _try_get_brcm_asic_name:
- "j2" matched by PCI device identifier "Device 869"
- "j2c+" matched by PCI device identifier "Device 885"

resolution.title: Add J2 and J2C+ variants in _try_get_brcm_asic_name
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary: Add J2 and J2C+ Broadcom ASIC variants to _try_get_brcm_asic_name so that platforms using these chipsets are correctly identified instead of returning UNKNOWN_ASIC.

Fixes #23758

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [x] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] New Test case

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
get_asic_name() returns UNKNOWN_ASIC on platforms with Broadcom Jericho 2 (J2) and Jericho 2C+ (J2C+) ASICs because their PCI device identifiers are missing from the search_sets dictionary in `_try_get_brcm_asic_name`. This causes any test logic that branches on ASIC type to misidentify these platforms.

#### How did you do it?
Added two entries to the search_sets dictionary in tests/common/devices/sonic.py:
- "j2": matched by "Device 869"
- "j2c+": matched by "Device 885"

#### How did you verify/test it?
Verified on J2 and J2C+ platforms contains the expected device identifiers and that get_asic_name() now returns the correct ASIC name.

#### Any platform specific information?
Applies to platforms using Broadcom Jericho 2 and Jericho 2C+ ASICs
